items.title: Approve the Minutes of the November 28, 2023 Meeting
Adopt the 2023 Prop L 5-Year Prioritization Program for Muni Maintenance, Rehabilitation, and Replacement and Amend the Prop L Strategic Plan Baseline
Allocate $23,040,000 in Prop L Funds, with Conditions, Appropriate $150,000 in Prop L Funds, and Allocate $6,000,000 in Traffic Congestion Mitigation Tax (TNC Tax) Funds for Eight Requests
Approve the 2023 San Francisco Congestion Management Program
